Exact VSO relationship is explicit at https://www.yolocounty.gov/government/general-government-departments/health-human-services/adults/veterans-service-office, which lists Davis Senior Center, 646 A Street, as Davis outreach location. This photograph is a Rotary activity in the venue, NOT a VSO appointment or evidence of VSO clientele. NOT the main VSO office at 137 N. Cottonwood Street. No reuse license established.
